decisions.statement: A change appends its lines rather than rewriting the file.
Lines are kept outside the commit.
A line rolls into the next numbered file where the ceiling is reached.
A line states one edit of the four kinds.
A line has the paths and bodies that edit names and nothing else.
A line holds whether the readers of that path owe the reading again.
A line with nothing there leaves those readers owing the reading.
The lines are folded into one answer before that answer is replayed.
The lines are read in the order the lines were appended.
No author writes a line here by hand.

definition: the edits an agent has answered and not yet landed
